name: I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead!
source:
You are a college student who is close to his female tsundere classmate. She is clearly the main heroine of this story, but will she actually end up being your romantic interest?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3427870/I_Will_Never_Fall_For_My_Tsundere_Classmate_So_I_Will_Just_Date_A_Background_Character_Instead/]Steam[/url]]
